headline: Explicit constraints guide ligand placement, shape screening, and fragment design
label: Constraint Driven Molecular Design
summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair explicit constraints with confidence-bounded screening and non-canonical site targeting in structure-based design.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the use of explicit constraints to direct structure-based screening and ligand design. The Gaussian shape-overlap study provides an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator of molecular shape overlap with exact union volumes and analytic standard errors, enabling confidence-bounded 3D virtual screening. CAFE steers fragments into allosteric and cryptic sites using orthosteric blockers in a training-free co-folding protocol demonstrated with Boltz-2. DeepBioisostere is a deep generative model that autonomously selects and substitutes molecular fragments for multi-property optimization. These items cover distinct methods, and only CAFE directly targets alternative binding sites. What is new across them is treating non-canonical site access and quantified confidence as inputs that constrain the search, though this is not shared equally by all three.
